system.name: CI-VID
system.one_liner: A dataset of over 340,000 coherent multi-clip video sequences with clip-level and joint captions for text-and-video-to-video generation.

content.argues: Each CI-VID sample pairs a sequence of clips with per-clip captions and a joint caption that states what continues and what changes between adjacent clips.

encoding.shape_means: rounded tinted card = one caption; a row of three frames = one clip
encoding.marker_means: numbers list caption fields; dots anchor arrows to clips; underlined bold spans in the joint caption mark phrases that state continuity or change
encoding.emphasis: The dashed frame on the pair and the underlined key phrases in the joint caption, which is what the dataset adds.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a dataset sample as a media stack on the left and colour-coded annotation cards on the right, with matching-colour arrows starting from the exact item or dashed-framed group each caption describes. Underline the key spans of the new annotation type so the reader sees what the dataset adds.
lessons.suits: Dataset papers whose novelty is an annotation layer (captions, labels, relations) over media items, especially samples with more than one annotation level.

evidence: Figure 1 shows a tutorial on modifying a black hanger, where the procedure unfolds through a sequence of clips
clip-level captions (orange box) describing individual clips and joint captions (green box) capturing continuity and change across adjacent clips.

summary: CI-VID is a dataset of over 340,000 samples, each a semantically coherent sequence of video clips with interleaved captions that describe both single clips and the relations between neighbouring clips, aimed at text-and-video-to-video generation. Figure 1 shows one sample on a white ground: four stacked rows of three frames from a hanger tutorial, with a vertical arrow labelled VIDEO CLIP SEQUENCE. A curved orange arrow leads from the first clip to an orange card, CLIP-LEVEL CAPTION (video content, camera angle, camera movement, background). A green dashed frame around the first two clips sends a green arrow to a green card, JOINT CAPTION, with six continuation and change fields whose key phrases are underlined.
summary_zh: CI-VID 是含 34 万余样本的连贯交错文本-视频数据集。图 1 展示一个样本：左侧是四行视频片段（衣架改造教程），右侧橙色卡片给出单片段描述，绿色卡片给出相邻片段的联合描述，关键短语加下划线，颜色与箭头一一对应。
notes: Prior label scope-overview kept, but the figure is one annotated sample rather than a gallery, so the variant is renamed annotated-sample. Panels are counted as 3 (clip stack, two framed and titled caption cards) following the prior pass; the cards could also be read as parts of one record. Typos in the printed figure: 'CAPTIION' and 'romoving'. The four pictures are each a row of three frames.
